sayLines.line: ⚡ TECHNIQUE UNLOCKED: Precise Mend! Your healing knows where to go. +50% effectiveness. (Your knowledge of Wound Care amplifies your field_medicine.)

You wake up with dirt in your mouth and blood on your hands that isn't yours. The sky is the wrong color — not sunset-wrong, wound-wrong. Jerome Webb. Army medic. From Columbus, Ohio. That was yesterday. This is now. You have: Knife roll, Mixtape, Field suture kit, Home key, Dog tags. That's everything you own in this world. Haven. Twelve people. The fire is lit. They found a deer this morning. Inside out. Not eaten — unmade. Like something was trying to understand how it worked. It didn't finish.
📓 Journal: the person in their 60s, with a burn-scarred forearm taught the woman in her 40s Herbal Medicine.
Dominic is staying at Haven as the camp healer now — tending the sick instead of ranging out.
